messages:
sophie: FYI incoming from AcmeApp — they've been getting intermittent 5xx and timeouts on hosted streaming endpoints since ~09:10 UTC. p95 spikes to 4.2s, customer reports SDK retry storms and billing jump. Tenant T-9234, sample request id: r_8f3b1. Can we triage?

jordan: Thanks. Can you paste minimal repro and any client-side logs? also which model/route are they hitting?

sophie: Route: POST /v1/generate (streaming). Model: rwd-instruct-v1. Repro steps below (from their SDK):
```
const res = await client.stream.generate({
  model: 'rwd-instruct-v1',
  input: 'long prompt...',
  stream: true,
  timeout: 60000
})
// client has default retries=3
```
They included these errors in server logs: `upstream: 503 Service Unavailable` and client shows `io timeout after 30s`.

ops-bot: Alert: Hosted-edge region-usw2 observed increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate between 2026-05-14T09:07:00Z and 2026-05-14T09:20:00Z. Spike: 18% -> 6% error rate.

samir: I'm oncall, taking this. sophie can you ask AcmeApp to temporarily set SDK retries=1 and add exponential backoff (jitter) to avoid billing loop? also request they send full request id header `x-rw-request-id` if available.

sophie: Asked customer to set retries=1 and send `x-rw-request-id` — they're applying now. Drafting a short customer-facing message: "We're investigating increased 5xxs and will follow up with mitigation and ETA."

jordan: Can we reproduce internally? lee, can you try hitting hosted edge with similar streaming pattern? I suspect long-lived h2 streams + large initial payloads.

lee: Reproduced on staging with the same client pattern. Observed connection resets from edge proxy (envoy) with logs: `CANCELLED: upstream reset before response`. Traced to upstream keepalive timeout + HTTP/2 flow control window exhaustion on some hosts.

jordan: Good find. Any quick mitigations?

lee: Short term: increase HTTP/2 initial window (pilot), bump keepalive on ingress -> 60s, and push a config to avoid draining active streams on host rotation. I'll prepare a canary. Patch: edge-config#2857.

billing-bot: Notice: Tenant T-9234 billing usage jumped 2.8x over the last 30m due to retries. Consider rate-limiting or issuing credits after mitigation.

samir: Proceed with canary to 5% in region-usw2. jordan, pls monitor p95 & 5xx. I'll hold rollback privileges.

lee: Canary deployed (edge-config#2857 -> canary-usw2 @ 09:45 UTC). Patch increases h2 initial_window to 256k and keepalive to 60s.

jordan: Seeing immediate drop in 5xxs on canary hosts. p95 lowered from 4.2s -> 0.9s for canary. continuing to monitor.

sophie: Customer update: "We pushed a targeted fix to our edge layer and are seeing improvements. Please keep retries low while we monitor for 30m. We'll follow up with a full RCA and any billing adjustments." Sending now.

billing-bot: Flagged for review: credit estimate pending for T-9234 due to retry storm.

samir: After 25m of stable metrics on canary, promoting to 60% at 10:12 UTC. jordan, keep an eye, lee stand by.

jordan: Metrics stable across promoted hosts. 5xx baseline back to normal (<0.5%). No other tenants affected.

sophie: AcmeApp confirmed errors reduced and they're stopping aggressive retries. Customer asked for ETA on full RCA. I'll schedule a follow-up 1:1.

lee: Root cause notes for RCA: intermittent H2 window / connection drain edge behavior under sustained streaming patterns + host rotation during autoscale. Fix: adjust h2 window, keepalive, and avoid preemptive draining for long-lived streams. Full writeup incoming in eng-runtime.

samir: Closing oncall action item, leaving postmortem to eng-runtime. If billing team wants to credit T-9234, coordinate with sophie.

sophie: Closing thread. Thanks all. :heart:
